i.norm: Verifies that replaceIn returns false when the TextStringBuilder contains no variable patterns (i.e. no "${...}" expressions), and that the default escape character is '$'. The text ":-" is the default value-delimiter sequence used inside variable expressions (e.g. "${var:-default}"), but here it appears on its own — outside any variable wrapper — so StringSubstitutor recognises nothing to substitute and leaves the builder unchanged.
":-" is the default value-delimiter but is not wrapped in "${...}", so no substitution occurs.
